name: Patient statement and explanation of benefits comparison
summary: A billing specialist answering a patient’s question gets the statement and the insurer’s explanation of benefits compared line by line by service date, every unmatched amount traced to its page, and a plain-language reply drafted for approval. Nothing on the account changes.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of healthcare billing work, and its own rules for prepared work: the supplied files as the only authority, every figure shown with its working, every judgment about codes or necessity handed to a named role, and a billing specialist who approves any reply or account change.
